query: SELECT cp.id as profileId, cp.firstName, cp.lastName, cp.ipipStatus, ir.clientId as ipipClientId, ir.domainScores IS NOT NULL as hasScores, ir.completedAt FROM client_profiles cp LEFT JOIN ipip_results ir ON cp.id = ir.clientId WHERE cp.firstName LIKE '%Gavin%' OR cp.lastName LIKE '%Waller%';
